newsitem.title: USA: Westell disappointed, sees ADSL role.
newsitem.headline: Westell disappointed, sees ADSL role.

text.p: Westell Technologies Inc said Monday it is disappointed it was not awarded an initial contract to supply modems to a consortium of regional Bell operators, but expects to be an important vendor to the companies in the future.

The consortium, which includes Ameritech Corp, BellSouth Corp, Pacific Telesis Group and SBC Communications Inc, chose Alcatel Telecom to provide the ADSL (asymmetrical digital subscriber line) modems, Alcatel said Monday. The contract was estimated to be worth $300 million.
